verificationSummary: Project Control records automatic WORK-to-PLAN return as mandatory for real FlowDoc WORK rooms. The Return Channel must deliver Terminal Handoffs to PLAN or a PLAN-owned monitor without requiring the user to copy/paste handoffs; manual recovery fallback can preserve work through task, thread, worktree, branch, commit, or handoff locators, but must be recorded as manual-recovered or return-channel-failed and does not satisfy automatic return. The contract also requires PLAN to handle multiple active WORK rooms through completionQueue, returnOrderPolicy, arrivalSequence, duplicate handoff handling, and one queued handoff at a time through acceptanceGate. GREEN evidence target: tests/flowdoc-automatic-work-return-contract.test.ts, related PLAN/WORK routing guards, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check.
